lines.t:
Great, both of them are
on Crossfire standby!

Note: a {{medabot}} on Crossfire standby
can't <c:ff00ff>evade<c>, just like when charging.

Also, if a {{part}} on Crossfire standby
is destroyed, the standby is canceled.

Now we just wait for the Crossfire
<c:ff00ff>trigger<c>:
an {{ally_battle_term}}'s attack that sets it off.
